41.name: Holiday Throwdown: Talking Turkey
41.overview: Jeff Mauro is here to prove that on Thanksgiving, the bird rules the roost! He enlists chefs Aarti Sequeira, Kelsey Barnard Clark and Andrew Zimmern to serve up bold flavors, bigger personalities and plenty of trash talk -- because this turkey day, only one chef will carve out a victory!

41.name: Holiday Throwdown: Friendsgiving Potluck
41.overview: Sunny Anderson kicks off the holiday season with a Friendsgiving takedown unlike anything Bobby Flay's ever seen! Chefs Damaris Phillips, Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso are serving up festive dishes with a heaping side of revenge.

41.name: Holiday Throwdown: Holidays in the City
41.overview: Carson Kressley brings some never-before-seen big city cheer to the holiday kitchen, enlisting hometown heavyweights Ayesha Nurdjaja, Michael Jenkins and Geoffrey Zakarian for a Big Apple showdown with Bobby Flay.

41.name: Holiday Throwdown: Ghost of Bobby's Holiday Past
41.overview: Carla Hall conjures up a holiday nightmare for Bobby Flay as he's haunted by three ruthless ghosts from his past -- chefs Amanda Freitag, Esther Choi and Maneet Chauhan. They've taken him down before, and now they're back, hungry for another victory. Will Bobby escape their grasp, or is he doomed to a devastating defeat?

41.name: Holiday Throwdown: Christmas Eve-rywhere
41.overview: Sophie Flay takes Bobby Flay on a high-stakes global holiday tour, celebrating Christmas Eve traditions from around the world. Chefs Gabriele Bertaccini, Claudette Zepeda and Brooke Williamson are bringing the heat to claim victory with a holiday feast Bobby will never forget!

41.name: Holiday Throwdown: Snowed In!
41.overview: Eddie Jackson recruits chefs Mei Lin, Tiffani Faison and Michael Voltaggio to turn Bobby Flay's kitchen into a winter "rumbleland." With their sights set on total domination, this powerhouse trio is bringing the storm -- determined to get Bobby snowed in!

42.name: Razzle Dazzle

42.name: The Thrill of the Grill

42.name: Arrivederci, Bobby!

42.name: Power Couple

42.name: Half Baked
42.overview: Duff Goldman and Amanda Freitag attempt to bake up a win against Bobby Flay with pastry chefs Yohann Le Bescond and Andy de la Cruz.

42.name: This Is How We Roll
42.overview: Bobby Flay is way out of his element with a signature dish he's never made before. Damaris Phillips and Christian Petroni taunt him as chefs Ilji Cheung and Pyet Despain attempt to roll up a win.

42.name: Southern Comfort
42.overview: Well, Heavens to Betsy! Jeff Mauro and Carson Kressley clutch their pearls as they cheer against Bobby Flay in favor of Southern chefs Alexia Gawlak and Austin Sumrall.

42.name: Shaken and Stirred

42.name: Oh! My! Gad

45.name: Holiday Throwdown: There's No Place Like Ham
45.overview: Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson welcome guest chefs Damaris Phillips and Viet Pham to kick off the holiday chaos with a spirited game of Spin the Bottle. Plus, it's the girls versus the guys this season, as Brooke's team includes chefs Antonia Lofaso and Ayesha Nurdjaja, while Bobby has chefs Michael Voltaggio and Michael Jenkins in his corner. Things get even smokier as the kitchen heats up for a festive, flavor-packed holiday ham showdown.

45.name: Holiday Throwdown: Swim with the Fishes
45.overview: Guest chefs Tiffani Faison and Gabe Bertaccini dive headfirst into Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson's holiday madness with a chaotic game of "Find the Pickle." Then, the teams face off in a high-stakes Feast of the Seven Fishes cook-off.

overview: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

seasons.name: Season 32
seasons.overview: Flay competes against a who’s who of chefs. For this six episode event series, the competition is expanded to three rounds as Flay teams up with one of the chefs that was just trying to defeat him. First, two of Flay’s chef friends will compete to see who will face off against a third chef waiting in the wings. The winner of that second round will then go on to battle Flay with each one picking one of the eliminated chefs as their sous chef.
